entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Returns' or 'Technical Support' to be routed to the correct department.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah, I need to start a return for an order I received a few weeks ago.
I can certainly help with that. Can I get your name and the order number, please?
Yes, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF-8675309.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order for the ClubFit Jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just a preference, I suppose. I ordered the jersey in my usual size, but it's the wrong size for me. It's just a bit too tight across the chest.
I understand completely. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me just check the policy for you. One moment.

Okay, Alex, I've pulled up your order details. It looks like the jersey was delivered 23 days ago. Our policy allows for returns on standard items up to 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process that return for you now.
Oh, that's great. So, I can just get a full refund?

Yes, once we receive the item back in its original condition, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Do you want to do a refund or an exchange for a different size?

Let's just do the refund for now. Now, I appreciate you making this easy. Since I have to go through the hassle of packaging this up and dropping it off, would it be possible to get a small discount code for a future purchase? Maybe for the inconvenience of the sizing being off.

I understand your request, Alex. While I can't offer a discount code in this situation, as we are providing a full refund and a prepaid shipping label as per our standard policy, I can ensure you're signed up for our newsletter to get alerts on all our upcoming sales and promotions.
Alright, that's fair. I figured it was worth asking. The prepaid label is a nice touch. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Alex. The email with the label has been sent. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
